title: Asian Cucumber Salad with Crispy Tofu
subtitle: with a soy, lime and ginger dressing
description: Crunchy cucumbers and crispy tofu in an addictive Asian dressing of soy, lime, ginger and chilli. It's refreshing, savoury and filling enough for dinner.

steps.text: Squeeze the tofu dry and cut into cubes. Add the cornflour, salt and black pepper and toss gently until all the cubes are coated.
Heat the oil in a wide frying pan over medium-high heat. Arrange the tofu in a single layer and fry for about 8-10 minutes, turning the cubes, until golden and crispy all over.
In a large bowl, mix the garlic, ginger, apple cider vinegar, lime juice, soy sauce, maple syrup, sesame oil and crunchy chilli.
Pat the cucumbers slightly dry and add to the bowl with the dressing. Add the coriander and spring onion and toss.
Add the crispy tofu just before serving and toss gently.
